result.rationale: A 3-year-old with 2 days of fever up to 102F who is drinking well, playful between fevers, and has no rash reports no red flags (no lethargy, dehydration, breathing difficulty, rash, or prolonged fever beyond ~5 days). Supportive care with antipyretics, fluids, and monitoring is appropriate; seek care if fever persists past 5 days, child becomes lethargic, stops drinking, develops rash, or breathing changes.
